name: Lovely Runner
description: Lovely Runner is a South Korean romantic comedy series about a fan who travels back in time to save her favorite celebrity after his death.

name: Stranger Things
description: Stranger Things is a 1980s-set science fiction horror series on Netflix about a group of young friends in Hawkins, Indiana, who uncover supernatural events, secret government experiments, and a parallel dimension.

name: The Witcher
description: The Witcher is a fantasy story about a monster-hunter for hire named Geralt of Rivia, whose destiny becomes intertwined with a powerful sorceress and a young princess in a medieval-inspired world.

name: Money Heist
description: Money Heist is a Spanish heist crime drama series about a group of robbers, led by a mysterious mastermind called 'The Professor,' who carry out two large-scale heists: one on the Royal Mint of Spain and another on the Bank of Spain.

name: The Crown
description: The Crown is a historical drama series that follows the life and reign of Queen Elizabeth II, from her wedding in 1947 through to the early 21st century.
